notes: External cohort origin is real, but test/external-informed selection can cause optimism. This is a mini-audit, not a complete PROBAST+AI assessment. No data or code execution was performed.

CP1.finding: Held-out data existed, but WHII Test and ELSA informed candidate/tool selection. No untouched final evaluation of the selected tools is established.

CP2.finding: Predictor selection was reported within WHII Training. Full pipeline reselection within evaluation bootstrap folds and all preprocessing isolation are unclear. No confirmed whole-dataset Type C violation.

CP3.finding: SMOTE/oversampling/class rebalancing not reported in inspected pipeline. No confirmed Type D.

CP4.finding: WHII calibration plots, slopes and horizon-specific O/E reported. External grouped incidence comparisons exist, but external calibration slope/intercept not verified.

CP5.finding: ELSA is an independent cohort by origin, but its results participated in model/tool selection.

CP6.finding: FPG/TyG measured at baseline predict future diabetes after excluding baseline diabetes; not contemporaneous label reconstruction. Residual baseline disease and event timing require dataset-level verification.

O11.finding: Not NHANES/BRFSS/KNHANES. ELSA sampling weights not reported in inspected text; do not infer weighted population estimates.

validation_caveat: External-source, selection-influenced evaluation; no confirmed untouched final test for the selected tools.

leakage_taxonomy.B: Unclear for MICE sensitivity isolation; not confirmed in primary complete-case pipeline
leakage_taxonomy.C: Not detected: feature selection reported within Training
leakage_taxonomy.E: Detected: WHII Test/ELSA performance informed tool selection
leakage_taxonomy.F: Not established: baseline FPG predicts future event; timing differs
leakage_taxonomy.G: Not detected: no artificial 50/50 balancing reported

additional_concerns: ELSA self-reported diabetes and differential outcome ascertainment
PH assumption verification not found in inspected text/tables
DCA thresholds and quartile groups are not validated clinical decision thresholds
